description: Test the EBM report generation skill with real project data

evals.name: Basic report generation with provided data
evals.prompt: Generate an EBM Routine P2 Environmental Site Assessment report. The OneDrive folder is at '/Users/sid/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-YourOrg/EBM_Reports' and the analytical Excel file is 'output_20260213_170242.xlsx' in that folder.
evals.expected_output: A populated DOCX report file (EBM_Report_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.docx) with: (1) Spill incidents as bullets in the Associated Spills cell, (2) Wellsite table populated with site info, (3) Per-area reporting sections with EC/SAR/Chloride analysis and exceedances
assertions: The output DOCX file is created and can be opened without errors
All INSERT_2_1_HERE and INSERT_4_2_HERE placeholders are replaced (not visible in final document)
Spill incidents appear as Word bullets with format: 'Incident # [ID]. [Date]. Substance spilled: [details]'
Wellsite table shows updated values: Site Name, Legal Land Description, Licensee, Spud Date, Wellbore Depth, Abandonment Date, License No.
Per-area reporting includes all unique areas from Excel data as Heading 3 sections
Each area section contains an intro paragraph with borehole/sample counts
Each area has 'Summary of Results' with bolded bullet points for EC, SAR, and Chloride
Background area chloride text includes 'Section 5' reference
Exceedance bullets appear when non-salinity parameters exceed guidelines
Category names (Good, Fair, Poor, etc.) are bolded in bullets
Chloride values are formatted correctly: integers without decimals, floats with 1 decimal place
